'''''Chaetopappa''''' is a genus of plants in the family [[Asteraceae]] which are known generally as '''leastdaisies'''.<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/151736#page/306/mode/1up Candolle, Augustin Pyramus de. 1836. Prodromus systematis naturalis regni vegetabilis, sive, Enumeratio contracta ordinum generum specierumque plantarum huc usque cognitarium, juxta methodi naturalis, normas digesta 5: 301] in Latin</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40005244 Tropicos, ''Chaetopappa'' DC.]</ref>

These wildflowers are native to western and central North America. The [[flower heads]] bear daisies with curled [[ray florets]] which may be white to shades of blue and purple, surrounding yellow [[disc floret]]s.<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=106357 Flora of North America, ''Chaetopappa'' de Candolle in A. P. de Candolle and A. L. P. P. de Candolle, Prodr. 5: 301. 1836. ]</ref>
